Title: Journey official product page
ObservedFact: PlayStation's official hero image places the traveler below a continuous dune ridge and keeps a distant summit structure above the horizon.
Inference: A persistent landmark and one dominant terrain slope can communicate forward travel without HUD arrows.
TestableHypothesis: Keeping the main route landmark inside the central 40 percent for at least three seconds will let four of five first-time viewers indicate the travel direction.

Title: Star Fox Zero official launch trailer
ObservedFact: Nintendo of America's verified-channel trailer shows the Arwing in a stable lower-center region while obstacles targets and beams expand toward the camera.
Inference: Stable player placement plus fast optic-flow objects can support high speed without losing the controlled object.
TestableHypothesis: A fixed player recognition zone and target TTC above 0.8 seconds will let four of five first-time viewers identify both protagonist and nearest hazard.

Title: Space Harrier official SEGA AGES page
ObservedFact: SEGA's official screenshots keep Harrier left of center and use a ground grid with rapidly scaling sprites around a centered horizon.
Inference: A strong vanishing grid and large near silhouettes make constant forward motion legible even with sparse geometry.
TestableHypothesis: A route grid occupying at least half the screen width will improve direction recognition over the current flat EARTH capture.

Title: Rez Infinite official product page
ObservedFact: PlayStation's official screenshots show centered lock-on targets layered over converging wireframe corridors with player action expressed by high-contrast color and line bursts.
Inference: The causal action can remain legible when target lock feedback and environmental depth share a single visual axis.
TestableHypothesis: Pulse onset within 150 milliseconds followed by a distinct peak and recovery will be explainable by four of five first-time players.

Title: ABZU official 505 Games page
ObservedFact: The publisher's official screenshots frame the diver against bright water volumes schools and large animals with clear near mid and far separation.
Inference: Biological scale is readable when the protagonist remains a contrasting silhouette and surrounding life supplies multiple depth bands.
TestableHypothesis: Keeping the protagonist above 1 percent frame area while preserving three depth bands will let four of five viewers identify both player and direction.

Title: Exo One official game page
ObservedFact: The developer's official screenshots place a small dark craft against bright terrain and pair it with monoliths beams or horizon breaks.
Inference: High-contrast landmarks can carry direction while a small player preserves environmental scale.
TestableHypothesis: A persistent high-contrast landmark with player area between 0.5 and 2.5 percent will improve goal identification without enlarging the protagonist excessively.

Title: Playwright v1.62.1 release
ObservedFact: The pinned release exists and the repository license is Apache-2.0; the project already locks the same package line for browser capture.
Inference: The existing dependency can generate project-owned current captures without adding runtime code or a new package.
TestableHypothesis: A repeatable capture command will reproduce three exact checkpoints and a 12-second clip from a clean source commit.

Title: FFmpeg pinned source
ObservedFact: The inspected source commit resolves from the n8.0.1 tag; the local Homebrew 8.1.2 build reports GPL-enabled configuration and is used only as an offline encoder.
Inference: Offline clip encoding can remain outside the browser bundle and no FFmpeg binary or third-party footage needs redistribution.
TestableHypothesis: The 72 project-owned frames encode to a 12-second WebM while package.json dependencies and Production assets remain unchanged.

Title: r/gamedesign environmental direction thread
ObservedFact: Participants cite Journey's opening dune and camera composition as a way to indicate where to go without a map marker.
Inference: Community recollection supports testing environmental landmarks but cannot establish the Production decision by itself.
TestableHypothesis: Blind viewers will point toward the landmark more often in a persistent-horizon candidate than in the current EARTH frame.

Title: Exo One control confusion discussion
ObservedFact: A player initially believed gravity and glide inputs were ineffective until controller remapping made the expected feedback occur.
Inference: Correct prompts alone do not prove understood causality when input-to-response feedback is absent or ambiguous.
TestableHypothesis: A first-use test that records exact input and visible response within 150 milliseconds will expose false understanding that a screenshot cannot.
